newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bodies from mass graves blessed in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: Bodies from mass graves blessed in Bosnia.

text.p: Around 2,000 people wept and prayed on Saturday at a religious ceremony for 120 people found in seven mass graves in northern Bosnia, before the bodies were taken away for burial.

Most of the 93 Moslems and 27 Catholic Croats were killed by Serb forces who conquered the Sanski Most area in July 1992. Others were killed when Serbs withdrew during a Bosnian government offensive to retake the region in late 1995.
All but 13 of the bodies had been identified, officials said.
Relatives and friends attended the ceremony, led by local religious leaders. Afterwards the dead were to be taken to different graveyards in the area where they will be buried.
All the victims were from Sanski Most and surrounding villages. A total of 16 mass graves have been found in the area so far and this was the fourth mass funeral held.
